title: Final Answer for (a)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly state that the scattering intensity I is proportional to 1/lambda^4.

title: Final Answer for (b)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly conclude that no net scattering results, I = 0.

title: Final Answer for (c)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide the correct expression for the net scattering intensity as if each molecule scattered independently.

title: Final Answer for (d)
description: Essential Criteria - The student must explain the enhanced scattering due to the Tyndall effect.

title: Angular Dependence Discussion
description: Important Criteria - The student should discuss the angular dependence of scattering, indicating the intensity distribution.

title: Fluctuation Explanation
description: Important Criteria - The student must explain the significance of fluctuations in the number of molecules for scattering.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should ensure that all units in their equations are consistent throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student must avoid common sign mistakes in their calculations, particularly in phase differences.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should be careful not to omit any factors in their final expressions for intensity.
